camera: Flat front-facing UI; a scrolling card collection grid. Cards are painted illustrations; no 3D.

hudLayout.topThird: Full-width header: top-left a tilted leather chapter book with gold numeral and CHAPTER; three dark inset counters (gold hexagon coin, green star XP, magenta meeple henchmen) with numbers; a four-segment progress bar with an amber fraction at right. Below, a polished dark-wood band with a rolled parchment quest scroll sealed in red wax with a yellow '!'. Then a khaki title bar: large pale-brown capital title at left, a dark inset counter pill with a fraction at centre, a khaki raised button with a magnifier icon and a capital label, and a crimson square X close button at far right. Under it two wide tabs side by side: left khaki (selected) and right stone grey, each with a small capital label.
hudLayout.middleThird: A 3-column grid of tall portrait cards in raised slab frames (each card ~30% of width, ~2:3 portrait), rows spaced evenly, starting at ~24% of height. Row 1: an unlocked teal-framed card with a bright painted hero portrait and a 'LEVEL 1' caption strip, then two grey-framed locked cards. Row 2: three grey-framed locked gear cards. Locked cards show their art heavily darkened and desaturated, a large white padlock at centre and two lines of pale text beneath.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Row 3: two grey locked cards and one teal-framed locked card (purple-lit dwarf mage). Row 4 cut off by the bottom bar (scroll affordance). At the very bottom a dark-wood plank bar: a small fanned hero-card stack icon left of centre, a wooden treasure chest with a yellow '!' above it at right, and a steel cog settings button at far right.

keyElements: chapter book, three currency counters and progress bar header
COLLECTION title bar with 1/31 counter, UPGRADE button and crimson X
one unlocked bright card (LEVEL 1), the rest darkened with padlocks and unlock text
teal frame on hero cards, grey frame on others
wood bottom bar with card stack, chest with '!', cog
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice chrome: khaki title bar and tabs, teal and stone-grey raised card frames with lighter bevel rims and darker front lips, crimson square close button; locked cards dimmed with a flat white padlock glyph. Painted card art inside crisp programmatic frames.
colorPalette: Warm wood and khaki chrome at top and bottom, a dark umber grid area where most cards are dimmed to muted browns, one bright saturated unlocked portrait (sky blue, warm skin) and teal frames as accents.
mood: Collector's anticipation — one card earned, many locked treasures waiting.
composition: Strict 3-column grid alignment; the single bright unlocked card at top-left draws the eye first, the locked cards recede into a uniform dim rhythm that scrolls past the bottom bar.
